transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to get next week's sustainment-training board finalized and published by 1600 today. The board includes the driver-certification block and the radio-procedures refresher for support personnel. Before I sign off on it, I need to hear from the S-3 and the motor pool chief on any schedule or readiness changes. Specifically, are all six training trucks going to be released and available for the standard driver-certification block on Tuesday morning? Let's work through any issues now so we can publish on time.

transcript.text: Sir, to answer your question directly: I would not recommend running a reduced driver-certification block with only four trucks on Tuesday. The standard block is built around all six trucks for a reason — it ensures every trainee gets the required seat time and instructor ratio we need for proper certification. Cutting it to four trucks would mean either shortchanging trainees on time or reducing the number of drivers we can certify, and either way we'd be running a substandard iteration. My recommendation is to push the full six-truck driver-certification block to Friday morning, after the remaining two trucks are released at 0800. That gives us the complete fleet, a standard block, and no compromises on certification quality. Friday morning keeps us inside the training yard's Monday-through-Friday availability window, and it gives you a clean board adjustment before the 1600 deadline today.
